title: Chokepoint arena variant — corridors connecting 4 quadrants via 1-cell-wide passages
intent: Source: arena-complexity spike (S230) #2 ranked recommendation. Most arenas today let players orbit each other indefinitely (esp. coward vs coward — see S210 HUMANS_DEAD acceleration). A chokepoint arena forces engagement: 4 quadrants of regular play, connected by 1-cell-wide hard-block corridors. The centre is a 3×3 plaza where the main fights happen. You can't ignore your opponent — the geometry funnels them at you.
rationale: Spike scored 13/15. Pure scene-authoring (no engine work). Existing bot pathfinding handles 1-cell corridors already (passableNeighbours just checks the movement layer). Adds variety to the rotation without touching gameplay rules.
acceptanceHints: DIMENSIONS: 17×17 grid (matches `cross` size for fairness with the existing 17×17 arena).
- 4 quadrants of ~6×6 cells each, separated by hard-block walls.
- 4 1-cell-wide corridors connecting each quadrant to a central 3×3 plaza.
- Each quadrant has its own spawn cell (1 per bomber, up to 4 bombers).
- Soft-block density inside quadrants follows the global default; corridors stay clear; centre plaza pristine.
BOT AI: no changes needed — pathfinding goes through corridors naturally. The choke makes bomb placement decisions more impactful (a bomb in a corridor blocks the only route until it fuses).
WIRE-UP: add to MAP_REGISTRY + MAP_DIMS + MATCH_ROTATION_POOL in `examples/kaboom-crew/bootstrap.ts`.
Visual: rendered arena shows 4 quadrants + corridors + central plaza.
Bot-vs-bot regression: a deterministic round resolves within budget (no infinite orbit).
Demo-30s snapshot baseline stays untouched (the new map isn't the default).
Diagonal corridors / non-axis-aligned shapes (keep the orthogonal grid).
Destructible corridor walls (corridors are HARD blocks by design — they shape the round).
Asymmetric quadrants (every quadrant identical for fairness).
